baseline.method: Independently executed upstream SOSR, repeated float64

reference_type: method reference, not physical ground truth
normalization: Uncentered cosine and RMS error divided by reference max-minus-min across both real channels
alignment: None. Full fixed grid and exact DN scale; no phase rotation or tilt fitting.
threshold_provenance: Ten times independently measured float32-input upstream NRMSE 6.6583485927655845e-9; float64 repeat difference zero. NCC chosen for numerical agreement, with NRMSE also mandatory. See test/validation.md.
